endorsements.quote: Authors applying GAI mode ls in healthcare must therefore carefully identify the most appropriate reporting guideline for their study, as these standards contain tailored items for studies involving GAI models5–8.

unlisted_practices: Journal editors and publishers should stay alert to updates in the GAI field and continue to encourage authors to adhere to relevant reporting standards.
Researchers should stay up-to-date with the literature and apply the most applicable reporting standards to their work.

Authors applying conventional study designs such as randomized controlled trials or cohort studies should continue to adhere to relevant reporting guidelines such as CONSORT and STROBE in addition to GAI-specific guidelines.
Investigators should apply CHART for chatbot health advice studies evaluating a single GAI model or GAI-driven chatbot, as well as in comparative studies between multiple models or chatbots.
